method: Read the exact NAS-backed outer ZIP once, extract its one XLSX member to a persistent local source path, verify its member CRC and size, then inspect workbook sheet names, declared dimensions and at most the first 10 rows of each of at most 5 sheets in read-only mode. Record the exact nested XLSX SHA-256. Identify whether date/vintage labels appear in those headers; do not load the full value matrix or calculate market correlations.
acceptance: One verified nested workbook, bounded schema rows, identifiable observation-date and vintage-date roles covering original 2011-2022 training and 2023-2026 reused held intervals. If first ten rows cannot establish roles, preserve needs_schema_adjudication rather than guessing.
stop: Do not scan all numeric cells, infer intraday availability from a date label, use current-revised values as historical or start Stage1 fit. Preserve exact source bytes and a concrete parser dependency if workbook schema is ambiguous.
